checkpoint.selection: none (passed explicitly; this script never chooses)

probe.feature: SetEstimator._head_input (pooled vector entering the output MLP)
probe.classifier: multinomial logistic regression, numpy, full batch
probe.standardisation: fit on the training fold only
probe.negative_control: database labels permuted, same k-way probe; expect 1/k
probe.lodo_centroid_ratio: standardise on the training databases, then compare the held-out centroid distance to the nearest trained centroid against the mean within-database spread
